ChangeLog: V8.5 Changelog * Added support for the new difficulty system on auto raid / auto dungeon with new settings like Upgrade To Hard / Upgrade To Extreme dropdowns and Katchin Reward dropdown. * Added Travel to Earth and Travel to Namek. * Added Auto Instant Transmission Mastery in Auto page, Special Modes section. * Added Auto Retreat to Auto page, Combat section. * Added Position Mode to Combat settings, with Orbit and Behind (Orbit is default for security reasons but Behind is probably safe and you might receive less hits). * Added support for blue beans in Auto Buy Beans. * Added "Apply Thresholds To Starting Form" to Auto Transform settings. * Added Highest Level Form option to Auto Transform. * Added Auto Party Respond to Misc page (Accept / Decline). * Added Infinite Zoom to Misc page. * Added "Server Code" input setting to Auto Join Private server so it's usable even if you don't own a private server. * Added Check State setting to Dash Vanish TP and Guard Breaker. * Added Only In Combat setting to Auto Block. * Auto Raid now forces Moro to go up to avoid his lava attack. * Auto Raid now dodges Majin Buu's Angry Explosion attack and Candy Beam attack. * Auto Escape now starts charging immediately while traveling. * Auto Escape in Raids now travels to the roof of the red barrier. * Auto Senzu now pauses punches and moves. * Moved Random Mode and Image Training Mode into Auto Farm’s settings. * Fixed game freezing for a while when respawning on FSR script. * Fixed Auto Healing Chamber. * Fixed sometimes still getting snapbacks when moving. * Fixed moves that aren't equipped in hotbar anymore still existing in Use Moves and TP Behind Moves dropdowns. * Removed Auto Infection Purge and Auto Collect Candy as Halloween event ended. * Added percentage distribution to Auto Stats, with percentage sliders for each stat, Single Stat / Distribution modes and Skill Points Reserve. Distribution splits your unspent points above the reserve. * Added Ignore Players to Targeted Combat and Combat, with Party Members and Friends options. * Added Prioritize Shiny / Katchin to Auto Farm settings. It kills those enemies and collects their dropped tickets. * Fixed Meta Cooler Auto Raid resuming combat after killing a clone. It now remembers the kill for each difficulty and waits for the raid to finish. * Changed the Meta Cooler Auto Raid hiding spot. * Improved a health stuck check. * Fixed Behind positioning getting stuck attacking enemies through walls. It now switches to a clear side and returns behind the enemy * Auto Escape now goes lower below the detect ground on raids. * Auto Raid now forces Moro near the top of the raid roof. * Fixed Auto Retreat returning to blocked positions when using Behind mode. ----------------------------------------------------------------------- * Improved slightly how the UI looks overall by default, settings under features are now cleaner, and added an useful search bar and Advanced Appearence settings group on settings page. * Added confirmation before deleting configurations or resetting all keybinds. * Added Overwrite Configuration to the Keybinds page on all scripts. * Enemies ESP default value is now 3000 studs instead of unlimited. * Fixed World ESPs causing severe FPS drops while moving if Distance setting was enabled and there were a decent amount of active ESPs. * Fixed section titles and inputs placeholders being translated into your Roblox language.
